headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for a thirteenth flat day, while marketplace scores stay far higher (Xocolatl 4.9 on Tokopedia) and short wear time keeps showing up in reviews.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily flat vs yesterday and 5 Nov: Alchemist 4.43, SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), HMNS 4.15; no product moved. Mykonos and Onix pages could not be read today.
Marketplace ratings run far above Female Daily: Xocolatl scores 4.9 from about 4,960 Tokopedia ratings (under 0.5% at 1–2 stars) vs 4.7 on Female Daily, and is 24% off at Rp227k.
Short wear time is the most repeated weak point: Omnia's community profile shows about 3 hours with intimate sillage, in line with earlier SAFF and ILIAD projection reports.
Body mists are a longevity weak spot: Cloud Mist Annabel Lee scores 4.7 but recent reviewers say the lychee scent fades within minutes to hours.
Prices vary by channel: Kirithra is Rp246k at Watsons (5% off), while a third-party reseller lists Cascavel at Rp189k (sold out) with no proof of authenticity.

recommendations.text: After 11.11, use the strong marketplace scores (e.g. Xocolatl 4.9 on Tokopedia) in ads and on Female Daily, and ask happy buyers to review there too, before Mykonos Soft Hour reaches stores on 15 Nov.
Align normal vs promo price messaging across website, Tokopedia, Watsons and Zalora so constant markdowns do not make 'normal' prices look inflated.
Set clear longevity expectations per Extrait (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with Omnia, S.O.T.B, Troupe, ILIAD and Cascavel.
Set honest wear-time claims for Cloud Mists (e.g. 'refresh every 2–3 hours') and bundle a mist with its matching Extrait for layering.
Publish an authorised-reseller list and a 'how to spot a fake' guide; run a quarterly survey (awareness, NPS) and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder.
